name: HRDecoder-FoundationDistill
network: same half-resolution continuous signed private adapter and HRDecoder; fresh ImageNet W48 seed42/private20261008
base_supervision: original squared Dice + .25 GT-positive/negative balanced BCE + .1 original HRcrop Dice
teacher_route: fixed GT-consistent T* base KL with fullGTpositive/negative denominators, .5*lambda_K; private all-valid KL unchanged
normalization: original BN unchanged; no BN buffer transplantation or per-image BN inference
gradient_clip: global L2 max5, finite-check then clip then exactlyoneSGD

critical_stop.action: save own current checkpoint and stop before another update; not an overfitting claim

changes_relative_to_detail: base positive-gradient guarantee, direct semantic teacher learning in provider, fixed clipping and critical-collapse stop
evidence: train-only21k probe shows EX/SE logits strongly negative and Dice positive gradients nearzero; BN crossover and batch-stat interventions do not restore these classes
hypothesis_not_guarantee: Prevent persistent negative-logit saturation and improve semantic distillation; exact initial collapse trigger and final fresh accuracy not established
inference: no GT/teacher/TTA/H4; native FP32 logit resize then sigmoid
